user.title: EverScent
user.description: Choose how to connect your EverScent account.

credentials.title: EverScent
credentials.description: Sign in with your EverScent email and password. If you only ever sign in with Google, Apple or Facebook, first set a password in the EverScent app (Forgot password) and use it here — or use the refresh-token option instead.

token.title: EverScent
token.description: Paste a Firebase refresh token for your EverScent account. Advanced: use this if your account signs in with Google/Apple/Facebook and has no password.

error.invalid_auth: Could not authenticate. Check your credentials or refresh token.

abort.already_configured: This EverScent account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The authenticated account does not match the one being re-authenticated.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Create a new schedule, or update an existing one when a schedule group id is given.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: EverScent device id (see the device's diagnostics or the schedule switch attributes).

schedule_group_id.name: Schedule group ID
schedule_group_id.description: Provide to update an existing schedule; omit to create a new one.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days the schedule runs (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday).

standard_setting_id.name: Standard setting ID
standard_setting_id.description: Use a built-in intensity preset instead of custom values.

diffusing_seconds.name: Diffusing seconds
diffusing_seconds.description: Custom: seconds of misting per cycle.

delete_schedule.name: Delete schedule
delete_schedule.description: Delete a schedule by its group id.
